title: Bugged Seattle hotel meeting and the journalist's death

tellings.quote: >> Turns out the place was bugged. Turns out a local journalist got a tape of the entire meeting and he dies shortly thereafter. Right.

plain: In 1947 a meeting in a Seattle hotel room, linked to the pilot Kenneth Arnold and a man named Fred Crisman, is said to have been secretly bugged. According to the writer Peter Levenda, who tells it without naming a source, a local journalist got hold of a tape of the whole meeting and died shortly afterward, which hints that someone wanted it kept quiet.
